RackMate T2 build

Everything going in the 12U rack: the PDU, the Mac shelf, the Flex Mini mount, the UCG Ultra mount, and the U6 Pro on a low riser with a fan under the top cover.

Show

The printed parts come from their real STLs. The rack, the devices, the PDU and the bought UCG Ultra mount are rough stand-ins. Positions in the rack are examples.
